baseline.description: Current main defaults, no arm contrast. Two reference prompts, repeated; records the starting wall time, cost and gate numbers.

p8.description: P8 (plan section 5, decision D1 option C): designed/uniform header vs reduced header default. Control A = origin/main behaviour; C = SVG_COMMON_HEADER_DEFAULT=reduced with no header mode in the body.
p8.requires: branch feat/svg-p8-reduced-header-default merged (without it SVG_COMMON_HEADER_DEFAULT does nothing and A and C are the same arm)

s3.description: S3: authoring profile revision 9 vs 10, chosen by the internal knob SVG_AUTHORING_PROFILE_REVISION (fresh admissions freeze that revision).
s3.requires: branch feat/svg-s3-prompt-profile-v10 merged (without it revision 10 is unknown)
